guideRules.text: Start with subject and action; describe multiple actions in timeline order.
Name the camera move: push, pull, pan, circle, follow, rise, zoom, or tracking.
Name the shot size: long, full, medium, close-up, macro, aerial, low or high angle.
Use style words such as voxel, felt, clay, or manga for stylized output.
Order the prompt as subject, movement, environment, camera movement, aesthetic, then sound.
Describe camera as starting composition, movement, amplitude, then ending composition.
Put dialogue in quotes and state emotion, tone, and pace.
Use one camera move per shot; label shots Shot 1, Shot 2, Shot 3.
Add constraints such as avoid generating text or subtitles, and no logo or watermark.
Use negatives only for subtitles or audio, for example No subtitles or No BGM.
Camera preset names work as prompt phrases: crash zoom in, dolly in, 360 orbit, whip pan.

templates.title: Product on stone counter
templates.prompt: @product sits on a dark stone surface in a minimal kitchen, warm side lighting from a single window, camera pushing in slowly from medium to close, clean and premium. No people, no text, no logos.
tips: Replace @product with your item.
Name the camera move: push in slowly.

templates.title: Daisy field macro
templates.prompt: Photorealistic style: Under a clear blue sky, a vast expanse of white daisy fields stretches out. The camera gradually zooms in and finally fixates on a close - up of a single daisy, with several glistening dewdrops resting on its petals.
tips: Start with the subject before the action.
Name the shot size: macro close-up.

templates.title: Drone obstacle flythrough
templates.prompt: At breakneck speed, drones thread through intricate obstacles or stunning natural wonders, delivering an immersive, heart-pounding flying experience.
tips: Name the camera move: drone tracking through obstacles.
Keep pacing fast with breakneck speed language.

templates.title: Rooftop dolly out
templates.prompt: A woman, wearing a white long windbreaker, with short hair and a well-proportioned posture, stands on the edge of the city rooftop, overlooking the night view with her back to the camera. The camera starts from her close-up back view and gradually zooms back, allowing more rooftop and city lights to enter the frame. The camera is required to be dolly out steadily and the light should not be overexposed. The woman's windbreaker moves gently with the environmental breeze, but her posture remains unchanged.
tips: Describe camera as start, movement, amplitude, end composition.
Order prompt as subject, movement, environment, camera, aesthetic.

templates.title: Chip macro spin
templates.prompt: Extreme macro of ridged potato chip with salt grains. Hyper-detailed textures: sour cream dollop, chopped chives, onion rings. Background shifts through amber-green gradients with floating dill, onions, milk splashes. Fast cuts, spinning vortex of onion rings, lands on "SNAPI sour cream and onion" bag with dramatic zoom.
tips: Use macro shot size for hyper-detailed textures.
End on the product with a dramatic zoom.

templates.title: Neon street frontal
templates.prompt: A man around thirty-five years old with slightly wavy black hair stands in front of neon lights on a city street, facing the camera directly. He wears a knee-length black trench coat, a dark gray turtleneck sweater, and leather gloves with metal buckles. His expression is calm yet oppressive. Neon reflections from the nighttime cityscape trace the contours of his face. The camera maintains a frontal perspective and slowly dolly in from a medium shot to a close-up, with smooth motion, stable composition, steady lighting, and a natural rise and fall of his chest as he breathes.
tips: Name the camera move: dolly in from medium to close-up.
Order prompt as subject, movement, environment, camera, aesthetic.

templates.title: Calm voiceover line
templates.prompt: In a calm emotional state, with an even tone and a normal speaking pace, say: "Let's begin with what matters most."
tips: Put dialogue in quotes and state emotion, tone, pace.

templates.title: Bookstore two-person dialogue
templates.prompt: In a warm, softly lit independent bookstore, two Americans—a man and a woman—stand shoulder to shoulder, flipping through the same book. The light falls across the pages and their faces. The camera makes an extremely subtle dolly-in, creating a quiet and intimate atmosphere. English dialogue: Man: "Did you ever read this one before?" Woman: "No, but… I think I want to, with you."
tips: Put dialogue in quotes and state emotion, tone, pace.
Name the camera move: extremely subtle dolly-in.

templates.title: Skateboard follow shot
templates.prompt: A medium shot from a flat position follows a skateboarding teenager, with a 45mm wide-angle lens level with his shoulder. When the front wheel rolls over a puddle, water splashes horizontally across the frame.
tips: Name the camera move: follow at eye-level.
Add lens detail like a 45mm wide angle.

tips: Shorten the duration to fit your model.

templates.title: Gummies selfie review
templates.prompt: Selfie-style close-up of woman with wavy brown hair, black leather jacket over white tee, pink nails, in car with sunroof showing blue sky. Stationary frame, bright natural light. She holds up pink "früns Superfood Heart Gummies" pouch, points to label, pulls out translucent red heart gummy, shows it to lens, eats it, nods approvingly, reseals bag.
